collision_check: Searched all 176 openkit-*/fbx for scabbard|sheath|chape|throat|wood-core|leather-wrap|locket|frog: zero hits; no openkit-scabbard*/belt* pack. All 4 ids free, no suffix needed.
judgment_calls: Workshop blanks only: no blade, hilt or assembled scabbard; distinct from WPN_* weapons and finished swords
Core: two uncarved flat poplar halves + scribed channel line + glue-up tie, reads as billet stock not a sheath
Leather wrap: 24 cm wide tapering cover panel with roll; distinct from narrow girth-strap-roll (saddler)
Chape/throat in brass with casting flash/sprue/burr to read unfinished; throat lug left undrilled
Contact-sheet eye-check pass 1: no floating parts; all parts touch/overlap; all under 120 tris
